methodologyNotes: The initial Vite audit server had the wrong working directory; it was corrected and page sweeps/interactions repeated. Only corrected runs are included.
Two exploratory requests targeted nonexistent /admin/data-export/stats. Those harness-only observations are omitted; actual download/delete authorization was verified separately.
Initial selectors for Create Form, Edit Form and Log out did not match Next, Edit and Sign out. They were corrected and relevant workflows rerun.
External delivery and IndiaMART/Process Sutra were not exercised. HTTP 404 missing provider settings is classified as unconfigured, not a location DTO failure.
Auth storage, cookies, environment files, credential values and request headers are excluded. Persisted business data is synthetic.
